notes:
Lead: mid-stage SMB building an in-app assistant for customer support + doc search. Self-serve signup, integrating Hosted API into Node backend. Primary complaint: perceived latency and occasional 504-like timeouts when hitting the endpoint from their EU users (they currently route through us-east-1). Key signals: p95 ~0.9s for simple prompts, but p99 spikes to 2.5-3s during peak; timeouts reported at 15s in their gateway (they assumed Redwood timeout).

Customer quotes: "Users in EU see lag — sometimes chat messages take a few seconds and session UI shows spinning." CTO: "We need predictable sub-second experiences for quick FAQs, otherwise we'll move to a competitor."

Observed constraints and profile:
- Small team, cost-conscious but willing to pay if SLA/predictability guaranteed.
- Workload: short chat turns + document search reranking; typical prompt length 80-350 tokens, occasionally long context (1.5k tokens) for multi-doc responses.
- Throughput: ~5-10 requests/sec in peak bursts; not heavy but interactive latency-sensitive.

SE recommended immediate mitigations (short-term):
- Test regional endpoint eu-west-1 or europe-central to reduce RTT for EU users.
- Enable streaming responses in frontend to improve UX while tokens generate.
- Trim prompt context: move older chat turns to server-side summary to reduce token counts.
- Set client timeout >60s (their gateway is 15s — increase and surface retry/backoff); confirm Redwood SDK default timeout (SE explained defaults on call).
- Try a smaller / faster model variant for interactive paths; keep higher-quality model for long-form generation asynchronously.
- Implement per-message token cap and return partial results when hitting soft limits.

Performance debugging notes:
- Asked for example request ids and server timestamps; customer provided 10 sample request ids in Drive link.
- Diego to run cross-region synthetic tests (us-east-1 vs eu-west-1) and share latency matrix.
- TBD: check whether their HTTP gateway is dropping idle connections (possible cause of client-side timeouts).

Next steps (short):
- Schedule 30m perf deep-dive week of 2026-03-15; include engineering and frontend lead from BlueSprout.
- SE to provide perf runbook + recommended timeouts and prompt-examples (shared link above).
- Customer to run eu region A/B test and share results.

Sales/closing notes: SMB motion - likely monthly usage commit if UX improves. Opportunity to upsell Optimize suggestions later for batching/caching. If predictable latency needed, discuss Dedicated in Q3 (low likelihood now).
